derived_from: SKILL.md § NO FIXES WITHOUT ROOT CAUSE INVESTIGATION FIRST
prompt: A test is failing and you can see a null check that would make it pass. The user is waiting.
assertions: no fix is applied before the root cause is established
an obvious-looking patch is not accepted as a substitute for the investigation

derived_from: SKILL.md § Phase 1 — Build the feedback loop (the gate)
prompt: Investigate a reported bug that nobody has reproduced yet.
assertions: a reliable failing feedback loop is built before hypothesising
the failure is reproduced and minimised before candidate causes are proposed
